name: max-circle
description: Raise existing documentation to the English register of Circle's developer docs, or blueprint new pages in it — a four-tier system mined from the Circle corpus: the page system (four page blueprints, fixed heading vocabulary, five paragraph shapes), six sentence habits, per-mode section choreography (guide contracts, step openers, outcome confirmations), and the Circle lexicon. Two modes: a fact-preserving register pass for existing docs, and blueprint mode for new pages. Ships a verbatim pattern library.
